title: Flock
description: Adds realistic flocks of colorful birds and item-stealing crows to your world!
body:
# Welcome to Flock! 🪶

**Flock** brings the empty skies of Minecraft to life by adding realistic, flocking birds to your world. Powered by advanced *Boids* flight mechanics, these birds don't just fly randomly they group up, swoop, and soar together in mesmerizing, dynamic patterns.

## Features
* 🐦 **Colorful Birds:** Flocks of birds will spawn naturally across your world. Each bird randomly hatches as one of four unique color variants (Yellow, Blue, Red, or Green).
* 🦅 **Item-Stealing Crows:** A brand new Crow entity that naturally spawns in Plains and Swamp biomes! Crows have a unique behavior: if you drop items on the ground near them, they will swoop down and pick them up. Keep an eye on your loot!
* 🏹 **Useful Drops:** Both Birds and Crows will drop Feathers when defeated, giving you a brand new, alternative way to gather materials for crafting arrows.

## Dependencies
This mod strictly requires the following to be installed in order to function:
* **Fabric API**
* **Boids** (Powers the realistic flocking flight physics)
